hafsa_privsec: Heads-up: DSAR erase for subj 'u-7e1' stalled during nightly run. Worker failed to decrypt snapshot because the snapshot was rewrapped to a deprecated key during a prior ops migration.
ashwin_eng: Can you paste the worker error?
hafsa_privsec: ```
2026-03-28T04:12:01Z dsar-erase ERROR RewrapMismatch: decrypt failed: keyVersion mismatch or key not accessible; caller=sa-dsar-agent@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
snapshot=snap-u7e1 job=erase-u7e1
```
ron_ops: Oncall. Looking at key history: snapshots for this tenant were re-encrypted by a backfill job two weeks ago onto `projects/.../cryptoKeys/legacy-dsar-v2` which we later decommissioned. The DSAR pipeline still expects alias `redwood-dsar` which points to new key. No automatic rewrap path exists.
marta_legal: Requester asking for status. If we miss statutory window, we must record a retention exception. Legal will permit an emergency re-encrypt or temporary key access but need full audit proof and justification.
ashwin_eng: Additional issue: I pulled audit logs and there is a ~6 hour gap on KMS audit ingestion coincident with the backfill. We have missing `Decrypt` events for that window, so proving prior attempts will be harder.
hafsa_privsec: Risk level: P1 for the specific DSAR SLA, P2 for programmatic compliance gap (because of audit ingestion gap).
ron_ops: Short-term options: (A) run a targeted rewrap of affected snapshots from legacy key to canonical alias using a privileged rewrap worker (requires breakglass on decommissioned key), (B) temporarily grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to `sa-dsar-agent` on legacy key for one-off decrypt+delete, (C) request requester consent to defer with documented retention exception.
marta_legal: Legal prefers (A) or (B) with strict time-bounded access and complete evidence. Approval template: include dsar id, snapshot ids, operator, justification, and attach KMS audit entries + infra-change record.
ashwin_eng: We need to triage vuln surface too: legacy key material touched HSM during the backfill; confirm no key export happened. Ops, can you check if any admin principals were added during backfill?
ron_ops: Confirmed no export; HSM logs show only rewrap operations executed by service account `sa-rewrap-backfill`. However the backfill job used a temporary elevated role that was removed after the run. We'll capture IAM change logs.
hafsa_privsec: Proposed immediate plan: 1) request legal approval for one-time breakglass rewrap on legacy key (owner: marta_legal). 2) ron_ops to run targeted rewrap->alias and resume DSAR erase. 3) ashwin to update DSAR pipeline to fallback to rewrap service if key alias mismatch detected. 4) infra to patch KMS audit ingestion gap and backfill logs (owner: ashwin_eng + infra). 5) create alert for keystore policy drift and for rewrap-pending snapshots (owner: ron_ops).
ashwin_eng: I'll open tickets and a runnable runbook for the rewrap worker plus test vectors. Also adding automated rotation smoke test to DSAR e2e.
ron_ops: Requesting emergency approval now. Applying breakglass request note in infra change: "DSAR emergency rewrap for dsar=u-7e1; reason=orphaned snapshot on decommissioned key; operator=ron_ops; approval=marta_legal"
sec-bot: Incident INC-5105 created by hafsa_privsec. Severity: P1. Link: https://incidents.redwood/5105
ron_ops: Executed rewrap job; delete job retried and succeeded: "erasure complete for u-7e1; snap(s) purged." Captured KMS events for Rewrap/Decrypt and infra-change record.
marta_legal: Approve closure pending evidence package: (1) IAM change record, (2) rewrap job logs, (3) KMS audit entries, (4) DSAR erase job logs, (5) confirmation sent to requester.
hafsa_privsec: Post-incident actions: - Add legacy-key rewrap check to DSAR preflight. - Build autonomous rewrap service to avoid manual breakglass. - Harden RBAC cleanup scripts to preserve DSAR-related SAs. - Fix KMS audit ingestion backfill. Owners: ashwin_eng (replay tests + rewrap service), ron_ops (alert + runbook), hafsa_privsec (compliance checklist), marta_legal (closure verification).
sec-bot: Incident INC-5105 status updated: Mitigated. Evidence uploaded to https://incidents.redwood/5105/evidence
